content_text:
Hi Roger,
Theres a video going around where a few VFX artists argue about wether or not in  Skyfall Daniel Craig is wearing a glove in one of the Shanghai scenes – or if its his real hand.
I figured this might be the only place to get to the truth! On the day of filming the scene were bond kills Patrice in Shanghai was he wearing gloves? or were the gloves removed for fake hands  in post? Im sure theres a funny story around the situation regardless.
Heres a link to the video to be specific, its quite funny . The time in the video where they talk about Skyfall is 4:25
Thanks!
